answer: You want 1,000 fake identities: admission auction makes you pay for each at a price you help set. Only 100 slots sell per epoch, by sealed bid; your bid locks 3 epochs, with a 2-epoch window to prove a bid forged and burn it. At 60 units clearing, 1,000 cost 60,000, while rival forgers push the price up — doubled demand, 120,000. The kernel is the sealed bid: blind bids force you to overbid, and losing bids still cost 2%. Honest agents pay once; the zephyr of cheap bulk entry is gone. Your spiral: more fakes, higher price — 10,000 identities cost over 1,000,000 units.
